description.value: Illuminaté Restorante is an owner-operated upscale Italian restaurant in Tsawwassen, run for over a decade by husband-and-wife team Chef Roland (trained at the French Culinary Institute in New York, with a Tuscan-style approach) and partner Joeqyna. The menu spans wood-fired pizzas, fresh handmade pastas, West Coast seafood, and dry-aged steaks, complemented by an extensive wine list and local artwork adorning the walls. Its location minutes from the BC Ferries terminal and Tsawwassen Mills makes it a convenient stop for cyclists arriving or departing via ferry.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website is fully functional and confirms an active upscale Italian restaurant at the OSM address. Takeout is evidenced by the What's New page ('we even do pizza takeout'); vegetarian items are marked 'V – Vegetarian' throughout the menu; WiFi is confirmed in the private Wine Room per the contact/reservation page. No bike parking, water refill, or washroom mentions appear anywhere in the website content. An internal inconsistency in hours across website pages (front page: Wed–Sun; about/contact subpages: Tue–Sun) is flagged as a concern.
concerns: Name discrepancy: OSM records 'Illuminate Restorante' (no accent) but the website consistently uses 'Illuminaté Restorante' (accent on the é). OSM tag may need updating.

Inconsistent hours across website pages: front page shows 'Wed–Sun 4:00pm–10:00pm, Closed Mondays and Tuesdays' while About, Gallery, and Contact subpages show 'Tuesday–Sunday 5pm–10pm, Closed on Monday'. One or more pages appear outdated.
Phone number (604.943.5900) sourced from website only; OSM had no phone listed — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible upscale restaurant with a working website, confirmed address, and current menu — well-suited to cyclists arriving via nearby BC Ferries terminal or Tsawwassen Mills.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu marks multiple items as 'V – Vegetarian' across lighter fare, soups & salads, and pizza sections (e.g., Portabella mushroom soup, Illuminate salad, Funghi pizza, Gnocchi gorgonzola, Funghi risotto)
